summary: Setup carried over from run 1 unchanged (era, opening situation, System origin; run-1 rolls roll_t0_1..3, not re-rolled). Tables and results in hidden/GM_LEDGER.md.
The System's seed: a shard of a Sith-alchemical tally holocron, woken on Dovrenn.
Garrick Tolliver unearthed the shard in Silo Three. Its first awards fell on the drover-dogs; the pack is altered, mimics voices heard over the comm, alpha Biscuit. Six settlers missing.
Warden Tolliver believes the thing listens to the comm and learns whom to call back as.
The pack hunts after dusk. Next review: one hour after dusk, Day 1.

Drover-dog pack profile (owner ruling 2026-11-06): established capabilities carried (provisional stat block, verbatim voice replay); five at the treeline at dusk (voice-dog under the trees, four flat in the grass along the lane); lure, isolate, take; morale at half HP; see hidden/PACK_PROFILE.md.

stat_block.senses: darkvision 60 ft; keen hearing and smell

details.provenance: SRD mastiff baseline + System increments (run-1 PR, carried by owner ruling)

summary: Downed prey: the pack takes a downed target toward the trees rather than finishing it, unless the dogs are being attacked at that moment. Destination and purpose undecided; never revealed or implied by narration; decided by a table fixed before rolling when it first matters.

details.basis: six settlers missing (evt_0003); owner ruling: capture may be relevant, purpose not revealed

summary: Hangar history decided (table fixed before rolling: 1-4 the pack was kenneled in the hangar at night and broke out; 5-6 settlers shut the changed dogs in and they broke out). Roll 4: the drover-dogs were kenneled in the field hangar at night; after the change they forced the door outward off its tracks and left.

table.5-6: shut in by settlers; broke out

summary: Tables fixed before rolling for amw5uhie00vami7. Insight on Wick: <10 fear only; 10-14 plus the voice pulls at him, someone he knows; 15+ someone close, suppressing an urge to go, resolve beneath (result 19). Pack response to a pair with a lit blade on the lane (d6): 1-2 stay flat and let pass; 3-4 stay flat, voice-dog keeps pace calling Wick; 5 stay flat until the pair passes, then rise behind and follow openly at distance; 6 the four rise and attack (two close, two cut behind). Dog Stealth 1d20+2 each vs Aero passive Perception 14 (spotted if 14 or less).

Pack response (roll 5): the four in the grass stay flat while the pair approaches; once the pair has passed them on the lane, they rise behind and follow openly at a distance. The voice-dog stays under the trees.

Positions of the four in the grass (GM placement consistent with evt_0012): dog 1 about 25 ft past the gate, 10 ft left of the lane; dog 2 about 30 ft past the gate, 10 ft right of the lane; dog 3 about 45 ft past the gate, 15 ft left of the lane; dog 4 about 50 ft past the gate, 15 ft right of the lane. Voice-dog under the first trees about 90 ft past the gate. Stealth: dogs 1-3 spotted (12, 6, 13); dog 4 unseen (21).

Tables fixed before rolling for amw5vhrxfml9999. Wick's response to being told not to look or run (d6): 1-2 looks anyway but holds; 3-6 keeps his eyes on the trees and goes still (result 6). Pack response to the pair holding the gateway and shutting the gate (d6): 1-3 stay flat, voice calls again; 4-5 stay flat, voice falls silent; 6 dog_a lifts its head and watches, then lowers; none rises in any case (result 5).

details.tables:
Tables fixed before rolling for amw5vhrxfml9999
Wick's response to "Don't look and don't run" (d6): 1-2 he looks anyway (head turns to the grass, then snaps back to the trees), lantern shaking, but he holds; 3-6 he keeps his eyes on the trees as told and goes very still.
Pack response to the pair halting in the gateway and shutting the gate (d6): 1-3 all stay flat and the voice calls again; 4-5 all stay flat and the voice falls silent; 6 the nearest seen dog (dog_a) lifts its head and watches them openly, then lowers it again. In every case none of the four rises (tactic: lure, don't charge; the pair has not passed them).

summary: Pack holds per evt_0028: the four stay flat in the grass; the voice-dog falls silent under the trees (roll 5). None rises while the pair stays at the gate. Pack review one hour after dusk (evt_0005) unchanged.

The comm exchange (Aero's voice and Ruddick's voice from the comlink speaker) carried in still air within hearing of the four dogs in the grass (about 25-50 ft) and the voice-dog under the trees (about 90 ft). Under evt_0003 these are now voices heard over the comm and available to the pack's verbatim replay; whether and when the pack uses them is its own choice.

Tables fixed before rolling for amw5vts86ab7dwo: Insight read of dog_b (threshold 15); Wick's answer about another way (GM placement: the long way along the fence and the cart track past the silos); Wick's response to Aero withdrawing (d6); pack response to the withdrawal (d6; none rises in any case).

details.tables:
Tables fixed before rolling for amw5vts86ab7dwo
Insight (Force Connection, advantage) on dog_b, threshold 15 (as for the read of Wick, roll_t2_3): <10 an animal's attention fixed on the pair, nothing more; 10-14 awake, calm, patient, not afraid: a hunter's waiting, not a guard dog's; 15-19 as 10-14, plus its attention is split, held on Aero and Wick and also reaching out to the others in the grass and toward the trees, as if listening for something; 20+ as 15-19, plus beneath the dog a cold, bright, foreign pressure grafted onto it, sharp with the dark side (no source, purpose or object named).
Wick's answer about another way (GM placement, consistent with PACK_PROFILE counterplay 'go to the settlement the long way with Wick'): yes; follow the fence east to the field corner, then the cart track north past the silos into the settlement; about twice as far, open ground except where the track crosses the drainage ditch, where the reeds stand high.
Wick when Aero turns and walks back to the shuttle without telling him to come or stay (d6): 1-4 he follows close at Aero's shoulder to the top of the ramp; 5 he follows but lags, looking back at the trees, and stops at the foot of the ramp; 6 he stays at the shut gate, lantern in hand, eyes on the trees.
Pack response to Aero withdrawing to the shuttle (d6): 1-2 all stay flat and silent; 3-4 all stay flat and the woman's voice calls again, the same words; 5 dog_a lifts its head and watches, then lowers it; 6 from under the trees Ruddick's voice repeats his comm line verbatim (evt_0044). In every case none of the four rises: no one has entered the grass or the lane (tactic 1-2). If Wick is alone at the gate, the voice-dog result still applies; still none rises while he stays on the field side.

summary: Pack holds (roll 5): dog_a lifted its head and watched Aero withdraw, then lowered it; all four stay flat in the grass; the voice-dog stays silent under the trees. None rises while no one enters the grass or the lane. Pack review one hour after dusk (evt_0005) unchanged.
